feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 September 2026 11:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 23 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic as a ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, but 3 or less in the southwest of the area, becoming variable 3 or less in all waters this evening, becoming southeast 3 or 4 early tomorrow morning, veering south or southeast 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east at first.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, quickly veering south and increasing 6 in western and central sea areas. Settling west or southwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate in western and central areas for a time.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain arriving from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
